fact: In his 6 May 2024 speech the President of the Supreme Court says that since 2016 the Judiciary has used IECMS, which manages cases from entry to judgment, alongside a Judicial Performance Management System.
title: Ijambo rya Nyakubahwa Dr. Faustin Ntezilyayo, Perezida w'Urukiko rw'Ikirenga, mu muhango wo gufungura Icyumweru cy'Ubucamanza ku nshuro ya gatanu
